name: F2L
description: The 41 ways a corner and edge can sit relative to their slot. Algs insert into the front-right slot; the front-left versions are mirrors.

cases.name: F2L 1
algs: U R U' R'
R' F R F'
U2 R U2 R'
cases.recognition: Corner in the U layer above the slot (UFR), white sticker facing front. Edge in the U layer at UR with its front-colour sticker on top.
cases.notes: Pair is already connected along the R face (front-colour on top of both pieces). U positions it, then the basic insert R U' R'. R' F R F' (sledgehammer) avoids the pre-move U.

cases.name: F2L 2
algs: F R' F' R
U' F' U F
r U R' U' M
cases.recognition: Corner in the U layer above the slot (UFR), white sticker facing right. Edge in the U layer at UF with its right-colour sticker on top.
cases.notes: Front-face mirror of F2L 1: the pair is already connected along the F face. F R' F' R (reverse sledgehammer) is rotationless; U' F' U F is the F-face 4-mover. The common y' U' R' U R is the same solution after a rotation.

cases.name: F2L 3
algs: F' U' F
S U R U' R' S'
cases.recognition: Corner in the U layer above the slot (UFR), white sticker facing front. Edge in the U layer at UL with its right-colour sticker on top.
cases.notes: Corner above the slot with white facing front; edge sits on the left (UL). F' U' F pairs and inserts in one trigger (F-face mirror of R U R'). Commonly also done as y' R' U' R. Primary alg, simulated: the pair is connected after "F'" and "U' F" inserts it.

cases.name: F2L 4
algs: R U R'
cases.recognition: Corner in the U layer above the slot (UFR), white sticker facing right. Edge in the U layer at UB with its front-colour sticker on top.
cases.notes: Basic 3-move insert: R lifts the corner next to the edge at UB (pair forms), U carries the pair over the slot, R' drops it in. Primary alg, simulated: the pair is connected after "R" and "U R'" inserts it.

U' R U R' U' R U2 R'
F2 L' U' L U F2
U' R U R' U R' F R F'
cases.recognition: Corner in the U layer above the slot (UFR), white sticker facing front. Edge in the U layer at UB with its front-colour sticker on top.
cases.notes: Edge must be repositioned: U' R U R' builds the connected pair, then U2 R U' R' inserts it. Learn this as the template 'pair, U2, insert'. Primary alg, simulated: the pair is connected after "U' R U R'" and "U2 R U' R'" inserts it.

algs: U' r U' R' U R U r'
R2 B U B' U' R2
U2 R' F R F' R' F R F' U2 R U R'
cases.recognition: Corner in the U layer above the slot (UFR), white sticker facing right. Edge in the U layer at UL with its right-colour sticker on top.
cases.notes: F2L 5's partner with white facing right. U' r U' R' U R U r' is the popular rotationless choice (wide-r keeps it R/U friendly); otherwise y' U R' U' R U2 R' U R (rotation, not listed). Primary alg, simulated: the pair is connected after "U' r U' R' U R" and "U r'" inserts it.

cases.notes: Corner white-front, edge at UL with front-colour on top. U' R U2 R' then U' R U2 R' (same 4-move chunk twice). M' U' M U2 r U' r' is a fast M-slice option. Primary alg, simulated: the pair is connected after "U' R U2 R'" and "U' R U2 R'" inserts it.

Primary alg, simulated: the pair is connected after "r' U2 R2" and "U R2 U r" inserts it.
